what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Puerto Rico, as recorded by IDMC.
IDMC's year-end count of people still displaced by disasters rose from 5 in 2019 to 1105 in 2020.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Puerto Rico list storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Puerto Rico.

when.text: The count fell to 146 by 2024; 2020 is the main year of displacement in the data.
IDMC records these figures year by year.

how.text: In 2024, IDMC recorded 341 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.
The sources don't say where people went inside Puerto Rico.
